objections.claim: Candidate artifact sha256:74c461918cbbd2db42255556ff2aa2a1a9139886138047ad9174c6991ae30d98 introduces a native launcher but leaves it outside the enforcement that is supposed to prove the v1 no-listener boundary. The complete-closure oracle is specified as a JavaScript import/spawn and capability grammar, while the scoped opaque-binary exception set contains only node, git, bwrap, and gh. Merely digest-pinning the launcher proves which binary ran, not that its native code cannot open a listener before Node starts; no reproducibly bound source/build closure, native-capability review, or adversarial fixture rejects a digest-authorized launcher that opens a socket. The release build also never explicitly produces, packages, or double-builds this sole supported entrypoint. Consequently the no-listener oracle would not discriminate this failure and the source-release clean-room contract has no specified executable launcher.
